sentences.text:
% 06.04.2026 CRL.M.A. 10289/2026 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 10/2020 of PS Pul Prahladpur for offence under Section 498A/377/323/354/406/34 IPC on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.

3. Learned APP accepts notice and strongly objects to this petition, taking me through the subject FIR, which levels very serious allegations of sexual misconduct against the petitioner no.2 besides very serious allegations pertaining to the offences under SC/ST Act, which is a social offence, so quashing is not possible.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 06/04/2026 at 21:49:09 4.
The respondent no.2 present in court and identified by SHO/Inspector Mahender Pratap also accepts notice.

5. On being pointed out the above circumstances, counsel for respondent no.2 submits that respondent no.2 has admitted that the allegations levelled by her in the subject FIR are false and that she is ready to submit an affidavit to that effect.
As requested, respondent no.2 may file the affidavit within one week.
